name: ETS proto-oncogene 1, transcription factor

function.text: ETS1 encodes protein C-ets-1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.
